review_feedback:
Human review for this local bootstrap (not autonomous runtime repair):
The earlier data-factory proposal omitted output.principal_id. Keep all declared
output wiring, with nested computed identity mocks and deterministic valid IDs.
The earlier databricks suite only checked defaults and invalid SKU; passing those
did not establish variable wiring. Include valid caller overrides (standard SKU,
public network disabled, custom tags) and assert no_public_ip, name and managed
resource-group wiring. Retain invalid SKU validation and both output checks.
For all four modules, cover existing observable defaults AND meaningful overrides,
empty/populated collections or optional blocks, output wiring, and concrete fixed
security behavior. Do not invent requirements or modify infrastructure. For the
function app, mock both providers including external result.revision; scripts must
not execute. Cover app-settings merge, role assignment wiring and computed outputs.
For private endpoint, cover DNS-zone absent and present, connection wiring and both
outputs. Read actual source and schema hints before deciding tests. Existing risky
settings should be reported to reviewers, not silently changed. Model outputs still
undergo exactly the same HCL, preservation, native and mutation checks.

Concrete review of the second attempt:
- In mock_resource.defaults, nested identity must be an object with only computed
  principal_id and tenant_id, for example identity = { principal_id =
  "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", tenant_id =
  "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002" }. Never mock identity.type. It is configured
  in the infrastructure and must instead be asserted on the real planned resource.
- Terraform mock defaults for repeated blocks use a single object applied to all
  instances, not a list of objects. Use private_service_connection = {
  private_ip_address = "10.0.1.5" } inside defaults; do not mock its configurable
  name, target ID, subresource_names or is_manual_connection.
- Use valid deterministic computed resource IDs only where necessary, including a
  service-plan ID under /subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/
  resourceGroups/rg-test/providers/Microsoft.Web/serverFarms/asp-test for function
  app dependency parsing. Do not rely on random computed IDs for parsed references.
- The private endpoint tags assertion used tags["Environment"]. On a missing key
  the evaluator errored before a test assertion could fail. Prefer lookup(tags,
  "Environment", "") == "test" or full-map equality so a missing key yields false.
  Assert actual service-connection target/subresource/manual configuration and the
  configured DNS zone ID, not just block counts. Preserve both output checks.
- Test existing fixed HTTPS/TLS/managed-identity settings and RBAC argument wiring
  for the function app. App settings merge must keep the mocked BUILD_REVISION
  even when the caller supplies a conflicting key. Keep meaningful overrides.
The sandbox formatting bug was corrected separately in fix/sandbox-formatting.
No HCL restriction, assertion requirement or mutation gate was relaxed.
